>>G<< 1ST-2ND SPEED SYNCHRONIZER HUB 
INSTALLATION
1. Set the output shaft on the press support stand.
2. Check that the 1st-2nd speed synchronizer hub is in the 
correct installation direction, and put it on the output shaft.
3. Using special tools MD998812, MD998814, MD998825 
<F5M42>, MD998824 <F5M51> and MD998364 <F5M51>, 
press install the 1st-2nd speed synchronizer hub with the 
press.
4. Make sure that the outer synchronizer ring on the 1st speed 
gear side can rotate freely.
